title: Umpire Accuracy Lab
description: Measurement lesson and structured debate on MLB umpire ball-strike accuracy. Covers scale of error (34,294 incorrect calls in 2018), two-strike count bias, performance evaluation framework, and pro/con arguments on automated ball-strike (ABS) technology. Inspired by BU Questrom umpire accuracy research.
data_vintage: Inspired by BU Questrom umpire accuracy research; Williams et al.
regulatory_citations: BU Questrom School of Business umpire accuracy research program
